title: Connection, API keys and the XML layout
text: How a broker reaches you, the keys they use and the OpenTravel layout of your answers.

title: Connection: the broker’s contacts and the addresses they send their messages to.
text: One address per message type, for XML, SOAP and the newer 2018A and 2024A versions.

title: OpenTravel XML layout: “OpenTravel standard” answers exactly as the official OpenTravel rules require.
text: “As connected” keeps the layout an existing broker was built against, until they confirm they read the standard one.

title: Schema check: every message is checked against the official OpenTravel rules. “Report only” shows problems in Traffic; “Strict” refuses invalid messages.
Record the OpenTravel version and SOAP version you agreed with the broker.
text: Traffic shows what they really send, so you can compare.

title: API keys: one secret key per broker. A live key for real bookings and an optional test key that only makes sandbox bookings.
text: A key is shown once when it is made; only a fingerprint is stored.

title: “Replace” makes a new key if a key may be known to someone else; “Revoke” stops it at once.
